<p>Because AI is inherently non-deterministic, debugging your application without any observability tool is more like guesswork.
Well-implemented observability gives you the tools to understand what's happening inside your application and why.</p>
<p>The core of this is <strong>application tracing</strong> — structured logs of every request that capture the exact prompt sent, the model's response, token usage, latency, and any tools or retrieval steps in between.</p>
<p>Langfuse captures all of this for you as you build. Here's an example of a trace in the Langfuse UI:</p>

<p>Start by <a class="transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-1 text-text-links underline decoration-1 underline-offset-2 decoration-text-links hover:text-primary hover:decoration-primary font-normal" href="/docs/observability/get-started">setting up your first trace</a>.</p>
<p>Take a moment to understand the core concepts of tracing in Langfuse: <a class="transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-1 text-text-links underline decoration-1 underline-offset-2 decoration-text-links hover:text-primary hover:decoration-primary font-normal" href="/docs/observability/data-model">traces, sessions, and observations</a>.</p>
<p>Once you're up and running, you can start adding on more functionality to your traces. We recommend starting with the following:</p>
<ul>
<li><a class="transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-1 text-text-links underline decoration-1 underline-offset-2 decoration-text-links hover:text-primary hover:decoration-primary font-normal" href="/docs/observability/features/sessions">Group traces into sessions for multi-turn applications</a></li>
<li><a class="transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-1 text-text-links underline decoration-1 underline-offset-2 decoration-text-links hover:text-primary hover:decoration-primary font-normal" href="/docs/observability/features/environments">Split traces into environments for different stages of your application</a></li>
<li><a class="transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-1 text-text-links underline decoration-1 underline-offset-2 decoration-text-links hover:text-primary hover:decoration-primary font-normal" href="/docs/observability/features/tags">Add attributes to your traces so you can filter them in the future</a></li>
<li><a class="transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-1 text-text-links underline decoration-1 underline-offset-2 decoration-text-links hover:text-primary hover:decoration-primary font-normal" href="/docs/observability/features/trace-ids-and-distributed-tracing">Use custom trace IDs for distributed tracing</a></li>
<li><a class="transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-1 text-text-links underline decoration-1 underline-offset-2 decoration-text-links hover:text-primary hover:decoration-primary font-normal" href="/docs/observability/features/token-and-cost-tracking">Track costs and token usage</a></li>
</ul>
<p>Already know what you want? Take a look under <em>Features</em> for guides on specific topics.</p>
<h2 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="faq"><a data-card="" href="#faq" class="peer">FAQ</a><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link size-3.5 shrink-0 text-fd-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path></svg></h2>
<div class="relative my-4 border border-line-structure bg-surface-bg corner-box-corners--hover"><details class="group relative overflow-hidden bg-surface-bg [&_summary~*]:px-4 [&_summary~*]:text-text-secondary [&_summary+*]:pt-4 [&_summary~*:last-child]:pb-4 [&_summary~p:first-of-type]:mt-0 [&_summary~p:last-of-type]:mb-0"><summary class="flex list-none items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-2 text-text-primary cursor-pointer [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden hover:bg-surface-1"><span>What is the difference between observability and tracing?</span><div aria-hidden="true" class="shrink-0 text-base leading-none w-3 text-center select-none text-text-tertiary">+</div></summary><p><strong>Observability</strong> is the broader capability of understanding the internal state of your system from its outputs. It encompasses tracing, metrics, and logging. <strong>Tracing</strong> is a specific observability technique that records the flow of a request through your system, preserving causal relationships between operations. In the context of LLM applications, tracing is the most important observability tool because it captures the full context of each request — prompts, responses, tool calls, and their relationships.</p></details></div>
<div class="relative my-4 border border-line-structure bg-surface-bg corner-box-corners--hover"><details class="group relative overflow-hidden bg-surface-bg [&_summary~*]:px-4 [&_summary~*]:text-text-secondary [&_summary+*]:pt-4 [&_summary~*:last-child]:pb-4 [&_summary~p:first-of-type]:mt-0 [&_summary~p:last-of-type]:mb-0"><summary class="flex list-none items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-2 text-text-primary cursor-pointer [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden hover:bg-surface-1"><span>What is application tracing?</span><div aria-hidden="true" class="shrink-0 text-base leading-none w-3 text-center select-none text-text-tertiary">+</div></summary><p>Application tracing records the complete lifecycle of a request as it flows through your system. Each trace captures every operation — LLM calls, retrieval steps, tool executions, and custom logic — along with timing, inputs, outputs, and metadata. This gives you full visibility into what happened during each request, enabling debugging, performance optimization, and quality monitoring.</p></details></div>
<div class="relative my-4 border border-line-structure bg-surface-bg corner-box-corners--hover"><details class="group relative overflow-hidden bg-surface-bg [&_summary~*]:px-4 [&_summary~*]:text-text-secondary [&_summary+*]:pt-4 [&_summary~*:last-child]:pb-4 [&_summary~p:first-of-type]:mt-0 [&_summary~p:last-of-type]:mb-0"><summary class="flex list-none items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-2 text-text-primary cursor-pointer [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden hover:bg-surface-1"><span>How does Langfuse compare to other tracing solutions?</span><div aria-hidden="true" class="shrink-0 text-base leading-none w-3 text-center select-none text-text-tertiary">+</div></summary><p>Langfuse is purpose-built for LLM applications, which means it natively understands LLM-specific concepts like token usage, model parameters, prompt/completion pairs, and evaluation scores. Unlike general-purpose APM tools, Langfuse provides features specific to AI engineering: <a class="transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-1 text-text-links underline decoration-1 underline-offset-2 decoration-text-links hover:text-primary hover:decoration-primary font-normal" href="/docs/evaluation/evaluation-methods/llm-as-a-judge">LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation</a>, <a class="transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-1 text-text-links underline decoration-1 underline-offset-2 decoration-text-links hover:text-primary hover:decoration-primary font-normal" href="/docs/prompt-management/overview">prompt management</a>, <a class="transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-1 text-text-links underline decoration-1 underline-offset-2 decoration-text-links hover:text-primary hover:decoration-primary font-normal" href="/docs/evaluation/experiments/datasets">experiments and datasets</a>, and <a class="transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-1 text-text-links underline decoration-1 underline-offset-2 decoration-text-links hover:text-primary hover:decoration-primary font-normal" href="/docs/metrics/features/custom-dashboards">custom dashboards</a>. It's also <a class="transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-1 text-text-links underline decoration-1 underline-offset-2 decoration-text-links hover:text-primary hover:decoration-primary font-normal" href="/self-hosting">open source</a> and can be self-hosted.</p></details></div>
<div class="relative my-4 border border-line-structure bg-surface-bg corner-box-corners--hover"><details class="group relative overflow-hidden bg-surface-bg [&_summary~*]:px-4 [&_summary~*]:text-text-secondary [&_summary+*]:pt-4 [&_summary~*:last-child]:pb-4 [&_summary~p:first-of-type]:mt-0 [&_summary~p:last-of-type]:mb-0"><summary class="flex list-none items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-2 text-text-primary cursor-pointer [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden hover:bg-surface-1"><span>Does Langfuse add latency to my application?</span><div aria-hidden="true" class="shrink-0 text-base leading-none w-3 text-center select-none text-text-tertiary">+</div></summary><p>No. Langfuse SDKs send tracing data asynchronously in the background. Trace events are queued locally and flushed in batches, so your application's response time is not affected. See <a class="transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-1 text-text-links underline decoration-1 underline-offset-2 decoration-text-links hover:text-primary hover:decoration-primary font-normal" href="/docs/observability/features/queuing-batching">queuing and batching</a> for details.</p></details></div><hr
